dialogues.speaker: Rather Aged Notes
dialogues.text: (These notes seem to have been plundered during a recent raid on the Fatui. The age of these notes has made the words difficult to recognize.)

dialogues.speaker: Rather Aged Notes
dialogues.text: "...Perhaps I overstep, but I think that Sir Nagamasa's mood grows better when he forges blades."

dialogues.speaker: Rather Aged Notes
dialogues.text: "...The obsession to cleanse the stain of the name 'Mikoshi' must eat at him..."

dialogues.speaker: Rather Aged Notes
dialogues.text: "...Also, Sir Katsuragi discovered a nameless eccentric while patrolling around Nazuchi Beach..."
